keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 10 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 40 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
news.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a model for fast execution in coding and agentic workflows priced flat across its 1 million-token context at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. It scores 51 versus 50 for Gemini 4 Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at default thinking level (54 at the xhigh setting), and Google also announced Orchestrator in Google Antigravity, which switches between models within a session and reached near-Carbon task success on Terminal-Bench 4.0 while using 24% less quota and finishing 19% faster.

news.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
news.summary: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2, a conditional DNA sequence model that takes a specified tissue, cell type or state alongside a 1-million-letter DNA sequence and predicts variant effects per cell type, including cell states not seen in training. Trained on more than 100 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues, it identifies nearly twice as many expression-changing variants as the previous model, and is available for non-commercial research via the AlphaGenome API and in private preview for commercial research.

news.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
news.summary: Google DeepMind made Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers via the API in Google AI Studio and Gemini for business at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, the same introductory price as Gemini 4 Argon. The company reports Carbon ranks #1 on CursorBench 4.0, Perplexity's WANDR and Zapier's AutomationBench at more than 2X lower cost per task than the next best external model, ranks #2 on the new Multimodal Knowledge Agent benchmark at over 6X lower average cost per task, and is previewing a /swarm multi-agent feature in Google Antigravity.

news.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
news.summary: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, a multi-LLM agentic framework that formally verified key security properties of the Signal protocol's compiled code, with agents powered by Gemini Carbon generating over six million lines of Lean. The verification took four weeks and needed human review of about one percent of the codebase, and when two previously fixed bugs were reintroduced into an isolated version, the system produced machine-checked proofs that the buggy versions were insecure.

news.title: Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity’s /teamwork
news.summary: Google Research described results from Antigravity's /teamwork multi-agent workflows built on the Gemini 4 Argon, Carbon and Hydrogen models, applied with human experts to open problems in mathematics, chemistry, systems software and ML engineering. The system pairs parallel exploration with verifiers such as the Lean 4 proof checker and software test suites, and partitions context so each agent receives only the files and tools for its step; features are available in Antigravity.

news.title: Using wearables to enable cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) risk profiling for personalized coaching
news.summary: Google Research introduced an investigational framework that derives a 'coachable health age' from wearable-measured resting heart rate, daily step count, sleep duration and weekly Active Zone Minutes, plus a SensorWM world model trained on more than 2.2 million person-weeks that simulates personalized 12-week habit trajectories. The framework extends to cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic risk profiling when routine blood biomarkers are available.

news.title: Exploring the world's languages with Language Explorer
news.summary: Google Research introduced Language Explorer, an interactive web platform built on the open-source LinguaMeta dataset that lets researchers, educators and others visualize data across thousands of languages, developed as part of the 1,000 Languages Initiative. It is featured as an interactive installation in the Museum of Communication Berlin exhibition opening this week and running through February 2028, with an online companion starting November 6 and a Frankfurt run through September 2029.

news.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
news.summary: Google rolled out Gemini 4 Hydrogen globally in Google Search, describing it as the biggest model upgrade to Search yet. The text cites improved intent understanding for multi-part questions and typos, expanded query fan-out and linking, more visual responses such as comparison tables and custom tools, and support across all AI Mode languages.

news.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
news.summary: Google DeepMind introduced the Gemini Decisions API and the Gemini Decision 1 model, which score up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple-choice (2 to 255 options) and rubric questions in one forward pass over multimodal input up to 256K tokens. It returns probabilities and confidence scores at 150-250 ms end-to-end latency and is priced at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with no output tokens billed.

news.title: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.
news.summary: Google Labs launched Tabletop, an experimental real-time collaborative space where groups prompt @tabletop or use templates to generate itineraries, polls, expense splitters and tournament brackets. It is rolling out in the U.S. for users 18+ via waitlist at labs.google/tabletop.

news.title: Experience the art and legacy of Dr. Esther Mahlangu
news.summary: Google Arts & Culture published the first online retrospective of South African artist Dr. Esther Mahlangu for her 91st birthday, comprising more than 45 stories and archival materials. AI was used with Google DeepMind and the Arts & Culture Lab to recreate undocumented memories from before her first recorded works in 1980, when she began painting at age 10.

news.title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering
news.summary: Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for a proposed IPO of 825,000,000 Class A shares, of which 801,351,354 are offered by Anthropic and 23,648,646 by existing stockholders, at an expected price of $70.00 to $78.00 per share. It applied to list on Nasdaq under the symbol 'ANT' and expects to grant underwriters a 30-day option for up to 123,750,000 additional shares.

news.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, described as the same underlying model, generating outputs up to 30% faster than versions 5.1 at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, with an optional fast mode up to 2.5x faster at $16/$80. Fable ships with cybersecurity and biology safeguards for general availability, while Mythos is available to organizations through the Life Sciences and Cyber Verification Programs.

news.title: Microsoft Research Focus – Edition #98
Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
news.summary: Microsoft researchers described "Lazarus," a backdoor technique that reprograms fewer than 10 dormant neurons in a model without retraining, causing an agent to execute attacker commands when a hidden trigger appears (for example, a date change past midnight into 2027) while still passing standard safety evaluations. Microsoft says Foundry verifies model provenance and scans the software environment, and it is developing AI-powered weight scanning, red-teaming tools and cryptographic model signing as defenses.

news.title: How AI Is Helping Care Teams Get Patients the Right Care, Sooner
news.summary: NVIDIA described Dyania Health's Synapsis AI clinical reasoning engine, which reads free-text patient records on NVIDIA-accelerated hardware inside a health system's firewall, built with NeMo and optimized with TensorRT and TensorRT-LLM. Cleveland Clinic used it on a study of more than 7,800 aortic valve replacement patients from 2005 to 2021 to model valve deterioration and reintervention risk at three, five and ten years.

news.title: A New Dawn in the Cloud: ‘Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV’ Is Coming to GeForce NOW
news.summary: NVIDIA said Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV arrives on GeForce NOW on Steam Thursday, Dec. 3, with more than 70 campaign missions and the Adeptus Mechanicus as a new faction. DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering comes to War Thunder in its mid-November Eagle's Shadow update, with the October model doubling performance versus the prior version (a tenfold gain since March), and to Where Winds Meet on Monday, Nov. 23; 10 games join the library this week.

news.title: How AI Helps Recyclers Turn Mixed Waste Into Reusable Material
news.summary: NVIDIA described four Inception startups applying AI to waste sorting, including Taiwan-based AIRECO, which runs vision models on Jetson Orin NX modules with over 95% recognition accuracy on its pilot line and aims to raise capacity from 18,000 to 48,000 tons per year while cutting operating costs by 85%. EverestLabs AI has about 150 robots deployed in North America and Australia and estimates its systems have identified about 40 billion objects, recycled roughly 25,000 tons of material and avoided about 30,000 metric tons of CO2.

news.title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Contribution and New AI Infrastructure
news.summary: At KubeCon + CloudNativeCon, NVIDIA contributed its OpenShell agent security and governance runtime to the CNCF as a Sandbox project and contributed to Google-led Agent Substrate, also a CNCF Sandbox project, with OpenShell reported to have received tens of thousands of contributions in less than a year since launch. NVIDIA also announced three new DSX AI Factory Platform components: NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine, NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes and NVIDIA Snapshot.

news.title: Faster Scientific Simulations with New FP64 Algorithms in NVIDIA cuBLAS
news.summary: NVIDIA's CUDA Toolkit 13.4.2 adds Ozaki-II and 2M algorithms to cuBLAS that run double-precision GEMM on integer Tensor Cores while preserving full FP64 accuracy, with no application code changes. DGEMM with Ozaki-II runs 5.5x and 3.9x faster than native FP64 on NVIDIA VR NVL72 and GB200 respectively, and CCSD and BerkeleyGW application cases report end-to-end speedups of 2x/1.4x and 6.6x/3.9x on those systems.

news.title: Run GPU-Powered Black Hole Interferometry with NVIDIA cuPhoton
news.summary: NVIDIA introduced cuPhoton.xBeam, a GPU correlator for Event Horizon Telescope very-long-baseline interferometry that turns recorded voltage data into visibilities. On a Vera Rubin NVL72 system with 64 GPUs and GPUDirect Storage, it correlated a 10 TB dataset in 70 seconds, about 460x faster than an x86 CPU baseline of 31,992 seconds.

news.title: Run Native DLA Inference in Python on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Using cuDLA
news.summary: NVIDIA released cuda.bindings.cudla in cuda-bindings 13.3.0, a Cython-generated Python layer over the cuDLA C++ API that enables hybrid-mode DLA inference orchestrated with CUDA streams on Jetson AGX Orin. The bindings expose thirteen functions, nine data types and eight enums, and the same API applies to NVIDIA RTX Spark.

news.title: When One GPU Isn’t Enough: Serving GLM-5.3 Across Two NVIDIA DGX Stations with vLLM
news.summary: NVIDIA showed serving GLM-5.3 NVFP4, a 753-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 40 billion parameters activated per token, across two DGX Stations with vLLM and tensor parallelism (TP=2), because the roughly 464 GB checkpoint exceeds the 252 GB HBM3e of a single GB300 GPU. On the SPEED-Bench Coding dataset, output throughput peaked at 607.8 tokens per second at concurrency 16 and fell to 385.0 at concurrency 32 with mean request latency of 453.5 seconds.

news.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
news.summary: Hugging Face published a walkthrough for building a pick-and-place simulation in Isaac Sim 6.2 using SimReady assets — a UR17G arm, Robotiq 2F-140 gripper and beverage can — from the SimReady Central library on Hugging Face. Task code for grasping, lifting, moving and releasing the can was generated with the GPT-6 Sol model and a chosen agent.

news.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
news.summary: Hugging Face and collaborators at Carnegie Mellon, NVIDIA and Johns Hopkins released XYBench, a benchmark of 8,115 real-world questions testing whether assistants detect the misconception behind an XY problem; it won the Best Resource Paper Award at EMNLP 2026. The evaluated models — Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Qwen3.5-9B and DeepSeek-V4 Pro — often answered the stated request while keeping answers focused on the mistaken approach.

news.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
news.summary: llama.cpp and ggml released version 1.0.0, committing to semantic versioning where major-version bumps signal C API and ABI incompatibilities in ./include. After 3.5 years of development, the project reports support for more than 150 architecture variants and all mainstream speculative decoding methods.

news.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
news.summary: Hugging Face released LLMON, an XML-like LLM-native markup language that uses reserved special tokens as structural delimiters and binds instructions to data via unique IDs, along with two experimental preview models, granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview and granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview, and a GitHub repo with tooling and JSON-to-LLMON converters. The post reports that on some benchmarks attack success rates from indirect prompt injections drop to nearly zero while general capability is maintained relative to Granite 4.1 Instruct models.

news.title: Theoretical Limits of Language Model Alignment
news.summary: Apple researchers derived information-theoretic limits of KL-regularized alignment, giving a closed-form expression for maximum expected reward gain at a fixed KL budget governed by a Jeffreys divergence term rather than the sqrt(KL) used in prior analyses, plus a practical estimator from base-model samples. They show the ideal-versus-proxy reward gap grows with reward error and smaller KL penalties, prove reward ensembling mitigates reward hacking, and find in safety and summarization experiments that best-of-N approaches the theoretical limit while PPO and GRPO remain substantially suboptimal.

news.title: Evaluating the Evaluators: Investigating LLM Judges for Personalized Writing Style Assessment
news.summary: Apple researchers evaluated LLM judges for personalized writing style using text from four LLMs on three long-form tasks compared against human pairwise labels. Judge quality correlated weakly with MMLU ability (Pearson's ρ ≤ 0.2), varied by task and criteria, was better with paired comparisons than independent scoring, and the strongest LLMs were not the most reliable at reproducing human evaluations; the paper was accepted at a NeurIPS 2026 workshop.

news.title: On the Importance of Gating: Memorization vs. In-Context Learning in State Space Models
news.summary: Apple and Harvard researchers show through theory and experiments that the gating mechanism in state space models causes them to learn an in-weights memorization solution first, delaying or preventing convergence to correct in-context learning even absent architectural memory-capacity limits. They also find gating often improves generalization to longer sequence lengths.

news.title: Weighted State Souping for Efficient Long-Context Retrieval
news.summary: Apple and Harvard researchers proposed weighted state souping, which learns query-dependent weights for composing cached SSM state encodings, improving long-context performance on single- and multi-hop document QA, needle-in-a-haystack retrieval, variable tracking and tool use. A sparse variant yields near-constant encoding cost with respect to context length; the paper was accepted at the PALM workshop at NeurIPS 2026.

news.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1
news.summary: AWS described how GS Caltex connects models built by process engineers in SageMaker Canvas to production SageMaker Pipelines workflows, automating the handoff of preprocessing flows and registered models. GS Caltex reports model deployment now takes a few hours instead of about a week, and runs batch inference every 30 minutes, which it says meaningfully lowered inference costs.

news.title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
news.summary: AWS published a sample deploying LiteLLM with the open-source NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing plugin on Amazon ECS and Fargate, routing coding-agent requests on Amazon Bedrock via stage routing (based on recent tool activity) or weighted random routing. It evaluates routing by cost per solved task, using switchyard-server 0.3.0 and the LiteLLM v1.102.0 image, and is marked as non-production sample code.

news.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
news.summary: AWS described Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime V2, which builds an environment snapshot once per create or update and restores it for each new session in a fresh microVM, giving session starts of about 2 seconds. V2 requires the first healthy /ping within 120 seconds, supports build hooks, and is presented alongside four patterns for moving work off the first request, including pre-warming on user engagement.

news.title: OpenFold3 on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: Predict biomolecular structures
news.summary: AWS made OpenFold3-preview deployable from SageMaker JumpStart to predict joint 3D structures of proteins, DNA, RNA and small-molecule ligands, outputting mmCIF structures with pLDDT, PAE and PDE confidence metrics. The release is version 0.4.1 (of3-p2-155k checkpoint) under Apache 2.0, runs on ml.g6.2xlarge, ml.g6.4xlarge and ml.g6.12xlarge, and uses asynchronous inference because real-time endpoints are capped at 60 seconds.

news.title: BAIR at CoRL 2026
news.summary: BAIR listed its participation in CoRL 2026, held November 9-12 in Austin, Texas, including an Early Career Keynote from Professor Negar Mehr and, on Monday, 10 main-conference papers plus 3 late-breaking posters. Papers include MEM, Diagnosing Compositional Generalization in Sequential Robot Tasks, Scaling Online Exploration for Robot Agents and Flip Anything with Agentic Robotics Self-Learning.

en.editorial: This week the field saw volume dip to 1,957 papers from 3,754 the previous week, with daily counts of 386, 863, 364, 0, and 344. Notably, LLM Safety, Security, and Alignment (change 1.51) and Generative Models, 3D Reconstruction, and Scientific ML (change 1.44) rose sharply. Among the most-read papers, WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence led with 58 upvotes, followed by Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence (53) and BirdDreams (46). For practitioners, G-STAR and MACaQ advance compressed generation and quantization, while Frontier3DBench and One Table, Many Queries offer new benchmarks. Read WorldFoundry for infrastructure, G-STAR for efficiency, and BirdDreams for driving world models.

Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen
news.summary: Google DeepMind推出了Gemini 4 Hydrogen，这是一个面向编码和智能体工作流快速执行的模型，在其1 million-token上下文中统一定价为每1 million输入token $1.50、每1 million输出token $7.50。它在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index上默认思考级别得分51，而Gemini 4 Argon为50（xhigh设置为54），Google还宣布了Google Antigravity中的Orchestrator，可在会话内切换模型，在Terminal-Bench 4.0上达到接近Carbon的任务成功率，同时配额使用减少24%，完成速度快19%。

news.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
news.summary: Google DeepMind宣布了AlphaGenome 2，这是一个条件DNA序列模型，输入指定组织、细胞类型或状态以及一段1-million字母的DNA序列，预测每种细胞类型的变异效应，包括训练中未见的细胞状态。该模型在68种组织中的超过100 million个单个细胞谱系上进行训练，识别出的改变表达的变异数量几乎是先前模型的2倍，并可通过AlphaGenome API用于非商业研究，商业研究则以私有预览形式提供。

news.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
news.summary: Google DeepMind通过Google AI Studio和Gemini for business中的API向开发者、企业、科学家和消费者提供Gemini 4 Carbon，价格为每1 million输入token $2、每1 million输出token $10，与Gemini 4 Argon的初始价格相同。该公司报告称，Carbon在CursorBench 4.0、Perplexity的WANDR和Zapier的AutomationBench上排名第1，每任务成本比次优外部模型低2倍以上，在新的Multimodal Knowledge Agent基准测试中排名第2，平均每任务成本低6倍以上，并在Google Antigravity中预览/swarm多智能体功能。

news.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
news.summary: Google DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, a multi-LLM agentic framework that formally verified key security properties of the Signal protocol's compiled code, with agents powered by Gemini Carbon generating over six million lines of Lean. The verification took four weeks and needed human review of about one percent of the codebase, and when two previously fixed bugs were reintroduced into an isolated version, the system produced machine-checked proofs that the buggy versions were insecure.

news.title: Advancing science & engineering with Antigravity’s /teamwork
news.summary: Google Research描述了基于Gemini 4 Argon、Carbon和Hydrogen模型构建的Antigravity /teamwork多智能体工作流的结果，这些工作流与人类专家一起应用于数学、化学、系统软件和ML工程中的开放问题。该系统将并行探索与Lean 4证明检查器和软件测试套件等验证器相结合，并划分上下文，使每个智能体仅接收其步骤所需的文件和工具；这些功能可在Antigravity中使用。

news.title: Using wearables to enable cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) risk profiling for personalized coaching
news.summary: Google Research推出了一个研究性框架，该框架根据可穿戴设备测量的静息心率、每日步数、睡眠时长和每周Active Zone Minutes推导出“可指导健康年龄”，并包含一个在超过2.2 million人周数据上训练的SensorWM世界模型，可模拟个性化12周习惯轨迹。当常规血液生物标志物可用时，该框架可扩展到心血管-肾脏-代谢风险分层。

news.title: Exploring the world's languages with Language Explorer
news.summary: Google Research introduced Language Explorer, an interactive web platform built on the open-source LinguaMeta dataset that lets researchers, educators and others visualize data across thousands of languages, developed as part of the 1,000 Languages Initiative. It is featured as an interactive installation in the Museum of Communication Berlin exhibition opening this week and running through February 2028, with an online companion starting November 6 and a Frankfurt run through September 2029.

news.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen

news.title: Gemini Decisions API: Fast, calibrated multimodal decisions
news.summary: Google DeepMind推出了Gemini Decisions API和Gemini Decision 1模型，可在一次前向传播中对多达1,000个是/否、多项选择（2到255个选项）和评分标准问题打分，支持最多256K token的多模态输入。它返回概率和置信度分数，端到端延迟为150-250 ms，定价为每1M输入token $0.10，不收取输出token费用。

news.summary: Anthropic, PBC启动了拟议的825,000,000股A类股票IPO路演，其中801,351,354股由Anthropic发行，23,648,646股由现有股东出售，预计每股价格区间为$70.00至$78.00。该公司已申请在Nasdaq上市，股票代码为“ANT”，并预计授予承销商30天期权，可额外购买最多123,750,000股。

news.title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
news.summary: Anthropic 发布了 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2，二者被描述为同一底层模型，生成输出的速度比 5.1 版本快最多 30%，价格为每百万输入 tokens 8 美元、每百万输出 tokens 40 美元，并提供可选快速模式，速度最多快 2.5 倍，价格为 16 美元/80 美元。Fable 面向一般可用性提供网络安全和生物学防护措施，而 Mythos 通过生命科学和网络验证计划向组织提供。

news.title: Microsoft Research Focus – Edition #98
Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
news.summary: Microsoft研究人员描述了“Lazarus”，一种后门技术，可在不重新训练的情况下重新编程模型中不到10个休眠神经元，当隐藏触发器出现时（例如日期变更越过午夜进入2027年），使智能体执行攻击者命令，同时仍通过标准安全评估。Microsoft表示，Foundry可验证模型来源并扫描软件环境，并且正在开发AI驱动的权重扫描、红队工具和加密模型签名作为防御措施。

news.title: How AI Is Helping Care Teams Get Patients the Right Care, Sooner
news.summary: NVIDIA 介绍了 Dyania Health 的 Synapsis AI 临床推理引擎，该引擎在医疗系统防火墙内的 NVIDIA 加速硬件上读取自由文本患者记录，使用 NeMo 构建，并通过 TensorRT 和 TensorRT-LLM 进行优化。克利夫兰诊所将其用于一项涉及 2005 年至 2021 年间超过 7,800 名主动脉瓣置换患者的研究，以对三年、五年和十年时的瓣膜退化和再干预风险进行建模。

news.title: A New Dawn in the Cloud: ‘Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV’ Is Coming to GeForce NOW
news.summary: NVIDIA said Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV arrives on GeForce NOW on Steam Thursday, Dec. 3, with more than 70 campaign missions and the Adeptus Mechanicus as a new faction. DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering comes to War Thunder in its mid-November Eagle's Shadow update, with the October model doubling performance versus the prior version (a tenfold gain since March), and to Where Winds Meet on Monday, Nov. 23; 10 games join the library this week.

news.title: How AI Helps Recyclers Turn Mixed Waste Into Reusable Material
news.summary: NVIDIA described four Inception startups applying AI to waste sorting, including Taiwan-based AIRECO, which runs vision models on Jetson Orin NX modules with over 95% recognition accuracy on its pilot line and aims to raise capacity from 18,000 to 48,000 tons per year while cutting operating costs by 85%. EverestLabs AI has about 150 robots deployed in North America and Australia and estimates its systems have identified about 40 billion objects, recycled roughly 25,000 tons of material and avoided about 30,000 metric tons of CO2.

news.title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Contribution and New AI Infrastructure
news.summary: 在 KubeCon + CloudNativeCon 上，NVIDIA 将其 OpenShell 代理安全与治理运行时贡献给 CNCF 作为 Sandbox 项目，并参与了 Google 主导的 Agent Substrate 项目，后者也是 CNCF Sandbox 项目；据报道，OpenShell 在发布不到一年的时间里已收到数万次贡献。NVIDIA 还宣布了三个新的 DSX AI Factory Platform 组件：NVIDIA Kubernetes Engine、NVIDIA Kubernetes Recipes 和 NVIDIA Snapshot。

news.title: Faster Scientific Simulations with New FP64 Algorithms in NVIDIA cuBLAS
news.summary: NVIDIA的CUDA Toolkit 13.4.2为cuBLAS添加了Ozaki-II和2M算法，在整数Tensor Core上运行双精度GEMM，同时保持完整FP64精度，无需更改应用程序代码。使用Ozaki-II的DGEMM在NVIDIA VR NVL72和GB200上分别比原生FP64快5.5倍和3.9倍，CCSD和BerkeleyGW应用案例报告在这些系统上端到端加速分别为2x/1.4x和6.6x/3.9x。

news.title: Run GPU-Powered Black Hole Interferometry with NVIDIA cuPhoton
news.summary: NVIDIA推出了cuPhoton.xBeam，一种用于Event Horizon Telescope甚长基线干涉测量的GPU相关器，可将记录的电压数据转换为可见度。在配备64个GPU和GPUDirect Storage的Vera Rubin NVL72系统上，它在70秒内对10 TB数据集进行了相关处理，比x86 CPU基线（31,992秒）快约460倍。

news.title: Run Native DLA Inference in Python on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin Using cuDLA
news.summary: NVIDIA released cuda.bindings.cudla in cuda-bindings 13.3.0, a Cython-generated Python layer over the cuDLA C++ API that enables hybrid-mode DLA inference orchestrated with CUDA streams on Jetson AGX Orin. The bindings expose thirteen functions, nine data types and eight enums, and the same API applies to NVIDIA RTX Spark.

news.title: When One GPU Isn’t Enough: Serving GLM-5.3 Across Two NVIDIA DGX Stations with vLLM
news.summary: NVIDIA展示了在两台DGX Station上使用vLLM和张量并行（TP=2）服务GLM-5.3 NVFP4，这是一个753-billion参数的混合专家模型，每个token激活40 billion参数，因为约464 GB的检查点超过了单个GB300 GPU的252 GB HBM3e。在SPEED-Bench Coding数据集上，输出吞吐量在并发16时达到607.8 tokens/秒，在并发32时降至385.0，平均请求延迟为453.5秒。

news.title: Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation with SimReady Assets
news.summary: Hugging Face发布了一篇教程，介绍如何使用来自Hugging Face上SimReady Central库的SimReady资产（UR17G机械臂、Robotiq 2F-140夹爪和饮料罐）在Isaac Sim 6.2中构建拾放仿真。抓取、提升、移动和释放罐子的任务代码使用GPT-6 Sol模型和一个选定智能体生成。

news.title: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
news.summary: Hugging Face与Carnegie Mellon、NVIDIA和Johns Hopkins的合作者发布了XYBench，这是一个包含8,115个真实世界问题的基准测试，用于检验助手是否能检测出XY问题背后的误解；该工作获得了EMNLP 2026的Best Resource Paper Award。被评估的模型——Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen3.5-9B和DeepSeek-V4 Pro——常常回答了所提出的请求，但答案仍聚焦于错误的方法。

news.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
news.summary: llama.cpp和ggml发布了版本1.0.0，承诺采用语义化版本控制，其中主版本号提升表示./include中的C API和ABI不兼容。经过3.5年的开发，该项目报告已支持超过150种架构变体和所有主流推测解码方法。

news.title: LLMON: An LLM-Native Markup Language, now in Granite 4.1 3B and 8B
news.summary: Hugging Face发布了LLMON，一种类似XML的LLM原生标记语言，它使用预留的特殊token作为结构分隔符，并通过唯一ID将指令与数据绑定，同时发布了两款实验性预览模型：granite-4.1-3b-LLMON-preview和granite-4.1-8b-LLMON-preview，以及一个包含工具和JSON到LLMON转换器的GitHub仓库。帖子报告称，在某些基准测试中，间接提示注入的攻击成功率降至接近零，同时相对于Granite 4.1 Instruct模型，通用能力得以保持。

news.title: Theoretical Limits of Language Model Alignment
news.summary: Apple研究人员推导了KL正则化对齐的信息论极限，给出了在固定KL预算下最大期望奖励增益的闭式表达式，该表达式由Jeffreys散度项而非先前分析中使用的sqrt(KL)决定，并提供了一个基于基模型样本的实用估计器。他们表明，理想与代理奖励之间的差距随奖励误差和更小的KL惩罚而增大，证明奖励集成可以缓解奖励黑客攻击，并在安全性和摘要实验中发现，best-of-N接近理论极限，而PPO和GRPO仍然明显次优。

news.title: Evaluating the Evaluators: Investigating LLM Judges for Personalized Writing Style Assessment
news.summary: Apple 研究人员评估了用于个性化写作风格的 LLM 评判器，使用来自四个 LLM 在三个长文本任务上的文本，并与人类成对标签进行比较。评判质量与 MMLU 能力的相关性较弱（Pearson 的 ρ ≤ 0.2），因任务和标准而异，成对比较优于独立评分，而且最强的 LLM 在复现人类评估方面并不是最可靠的；该论文已被 NeurIPS 2026 的一个研讨会接收。

news.title: On the Importance of Gating: Memorization vs. In-Context Learning in State Space Models
news.summary: Apple和Harvard研究人员通过理论和实验表明，状态空间模型中的门控机制导致它们首先学习权重内记忆解，从而延迟或阻止收敛到正确的上下文学习，即使没有架构上的记忆容量限制。他们还发现，门控通常能改善对更长序列长度的泛化。

news.title: Weighted State Souping for Efficient Long-Context Retrieval
news.summary: Apple和Harvard研究人员提出了加权状态汤（weighted state souping），该方法学习查询相关的权重来组合缓存的SSM状态编码，在单跳和多跳文档QA、大海捞针检索、变量跟踪和工具使用方面改善了长上下文性能。一个稀疏变体使得编码成本相对于上下文长度几乎恒定；该论文被NeurIPS 2026的PALM workshop接收。

news.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1
news.summary: AWS描述了GS Caltex如何将工艺工程师在SageMaker Canvas中构建的模型连接到生产SageMaker Pipelines工作流，实现预处理流程和已注册模型的自动化交接。GS Caltex报告称，模型部署现在只需几个小时，而以前大约需要一周，并且每30分钟运行一次批量推理，这据称显著降低了推理成本。

news.title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard
news.summary: AWS发布了一个示例，在Amazon ECS和Fargate上部署LiteLLM与开源NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard路由插件，通过阶段路由（基于最近的工具活动）或加权随机路由在Amazon Bedrock上路由编码智能体请求。该示例按每个已解决任务的成本评估路由，使用switchyard-server 0.3.0和LiteLLM v1.102.0镜像，并标记为非生产示例代码。

news.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime
news.summary: AWS 介绍了 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 运行时 V2，该运行时在每次创建或更新时构建一次环境快照，并在新的 microVM 中为每个新会话恢复该快照，使会话启动时间约为 2 秒。V2 要求在 120 秒内完成首次健康 /ping，支持构建钩子，并与四种将工作移出第一个请求的模式一起呈现，包括在用户参与时进行预热。

news.title: OpenFold3 on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: Predict biomolecular structures
news.summary: AWS使OpenFold3-preview可从SageMaker JumpStart部署，以预测蛋白质、DNA、RNA和小分子配体的联合3D结构，输出带有pLDDT、PAE和PDE置信度指标的mmCIF结构。该发布版本为0.4.1（of3-p2-155k checkpoint），采用Apache 2.0许可证，可在ml.g6.2xlarge、ml.g6.4xlarge和ml.g6.12xlarge上运行，并使用异步推理，因为实时端点限制为60秒。

news.title: BAIR at CoRL 2026
news.summary: BAIR listed its participation in CoRL 2026, held November 9-12 in Austin, Texas, including an Early Career Keynote from Professor Negar Mehr and, on Monday, 10 main-conference papers plus 3 late-breaking posters. Papers include MEM, Diagnosing Compositional Generalization in Sequential Robot Tasks, Scaling Online Exploration for Robot Agents and Flip Anything with Agentic Robotics Self-Learning.
